articles.title: Fauci Lied to Congress: Rand Paul Demands DOJ Prosecution for Perjury on Gain-of-Function Funding
articles.summary: Senator Rand Paul has formally referred Dr. Anthony Fauci to the Department of Justice for alleged perjury during 2021 congressional testimony, asserting Fauci knowingly lied when he denied NIH funding of gain-of-function research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology. The charge strikes at the core of the COVID-19 origins cover-up — a narrative the NIH and Fauci worked aggressively to suppress. If DOJ acts, it would mark the first criminal accountability attempt against the architect of America's pandemic response.

articles.title: Doctors and Researchers Go on Record: Big Business Has Captured the Global Health System

The fact that this conversation is happening in courtrooms and not medical journals tells you everything about who controls the narrative.

articles.title: COVID Billing Fraud Confirmed: Plano Clinics Pay $20M After Swabbing Patients and Billing Fake Office Visits

This is not an isolated case; it is a window into the industrialized grift that defined the COVID response economy, where federal emergency spending became a feeding trough for bad actors. The patients were props. The billing codes were the product.

articles.title: Medical Monopoly Exposed: How Conventional Medicine Systematically Buried Naturopathic Healing

Licensing boards, medical journals, and insurance reimbursement structures have all been weaponized to keep patients dependent on patented treatments rather than whole-system approaches. The suppression isn't incidental — it's the business model.

articles.title: Beta Bionics Hid FDA Safety Failures on iLet Device While Cashing In on Investors — Now Faces Fraud Lawsuit

A securities fraud class action has now been filed, but the deeper question is why FDA-facing safety data was withheld from the public in the first place. Medical device safety suppression is pharma fraud by another name.

When the cover unraveled, the stock dropped 8% — but for the patients living inside these facilities, the cost was measured in suffering, not share price. Regulatory capture allowed this to fester unchallenged.

articles.title: Live Vaccines Accidentally Given to 220 Immunocompromised Patients — Zero Infections. So Why Is the Warning Still in Place?
articles.summary: A study of 220 IBD patients on immunosuppressive biologics who accidentally received live vaccines — including MMR and varicella — found zero cases of measles, mumps, or chickenpox, directly challenging the blanket contraindication that has denied these protections to vulnerable patients for decades. The finding raises an urgent question: if the safety signal that drove this policy doesn't hold in real-world data, who is reviewing the guidance and why hasn't it changed? Blanket rules built on theoretical risk are still keeping real patients unprotected.
